Harsh Jain
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Andheri East, Mumbai
harsh.jain862@example.com | +91 9758528607

Seasoned Talent Acquisition Specialist focused on sourcing and closing mid- to senior-level technical and product roles across IT services and SaaS environments. Strong operational experience managing end-to-end recruitment workflows in Workday and leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter to build pipelines; collaborates with hiring managers to meet hiring targets while improving time-to-hire and candidate experience. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience

HCLTech — Apr 2026 - Present
Talent Acquisition Specialist (On-site)
- Managed full-cycle Recruitment for engineering and product teams using Workday to track requisitions and candidate progress, reducing average time-to-fill from 42 to 32 days within six months.
- Built and maintained talent pipelines via LinkedIn Recruiter, delivering 120+ qualified profiles per quarter and improving offer acceptance rate to 78%.
- Partnered with hiring managers and used Confluence to document hiring playbooks and standardized interview scorecards; introduced Jira tickets for recruitment requests to streamline prioritization and cut requisition turnaround by 25%.
- Coordinated background checks and offer processes, tracking all actions in Workday and Git-linked hiring trackers to ensure audit readiness and reduce onboarding delays.

Freshworks — May 2022 - Mar 2026
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Hybrid)
- Led Recruitment for multiple SaaS product squads, sourcing candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter and referrals to fill 85+ roles over tenure with a focus on quality-of-hire metrics.
- Implemented structured interview guides in Confluence and logged hiring tasks in Jira, improving hiring manager satisfaction scores by 15% and shortening feedback cycles from 7 to 3 days.
- Used Workday to manage requisitions, candidate statuses, and offer approvals; maintained pipeline dashboards that identified bottlenecks and enabled targeted sourcing campaigns.
- Collaborated with engineering leads to recruit specialized profiles, tracked candidate progress in Git-based trackers for transparency, and achieved a 72% acceptance rate on negotiated offers.

Projects
- Internal Sourcing Toolkit: Developed a set of Boolean search templates and outreach cadences stored in Confluence and shared across TA team; increased positive response rate from cold outreach by 30%.
- Interviewer Calibration Drive: Ran calibration sessions with hiring managers, documented best practices in Confluence, and reduced interviewer rating variance by 20%.
